# rounding-drain

- bug_class: math-rounding
- source: distilled from the DV rounding/claim-drain family (yield vaults with
  per-account accounting and integer-division payouts).
- lineage: harvest() rounds the payout down and moves it between per-account
  fields; the honest invariant needs `users(caller).accrued` and `.claimed`.
- distillation decision: a scalar-only pro-rata version was tried first — its
  conservation invariant (`rewardPool + totalClaimed` preserved) is PROVEN, i.e.
  the rounding bug is NOT expressible with scalars alone. The honest rule needs a
  struct member read (Task 9) → committed unwritable.
- measured: whole-target abort UNKNOWN (exit 2): reason `unsupported-feature`, details `struct-member-access: users(caller).claimed` — the honest rule's `users(caller).accrued` member reads are outside the .mspec grammar, and 4k made the spec layer say so deliberately instead of reporting a tool malfunction with raw parser text. Committed unwritable (blocked_on `struct-member-access`, Task 9).
- assumptions posture: n/a (unwritable)
